title: The Wobbly Little Penguin
prompt: Upbeat cheerful children's song, bouncy acoustic guitar, playful glockenspiel, light energetic drums, happy and whimsical, bright clear production, enthusiastic female lead vocalist with a warm and friendly tone, accompanied by a joyful kids choir on the chorus
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Waddle waddle!)
(Step, step! Let's go!)

[Verse 1]
I know a little bird who loves the snow
He doesn't fly up high, he stays down low
With a black and white suit, he looks so neat
Wobbly wobbly walks on his two orange feet!

[Pre-Chorus]
Oh, look at him go, left and right
[building energy]
Such a very silly sight!

[Chorus]
[joyful kids choir joins]
Waddle waddle waddle, slide on the ice!
Being a penguin is really quite nice!
Flap your little flippers, one, two, three!
Wobbly little penguin, dance with me!

[Verse 2]
When the wind gets cold, he doesn't mind
He huddles with his friends, close behind
And when it's time to swim, he dives right in
Splishy splashy water on his penguin skin!

[Pre-Chorus]
Oh, look at him go, left and right
[building energy]
Such a very silly sight!

[Chorus]
[joyful kids choir joins]
Waddle waddle waddle, slide on the ice!
Being a penguin is really quite nice!
Flap your little flippers, one, two, three!
Wobbly little penguin, dance with me!

[Instrumental Interlude]
[Playful glockenspiel solo]

[Bridge]
[clapping beat only]
Slide, slide, on your tummy! (wheee!)
Catch a little fish, oh so yummy! (yum!)
Up, down, spin around
Make a little happy penguin sound! (Honk! Honk!)

[Chorus]
[maximum energy]
Waddle waddle waddle, slide on the ice!
Being a penguin is really quite nice!
Flap your little flippers, one, two, three!
Wobbly little penguin, dance with me!

[Outro]
Waddle, waddle... 
(giggles)
Bye bye, penguin!
